text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
It's all 'cause I wasn't good enough that 
I lost last time... *sniffle*.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Wait, like that matters at all! I'll claw 
my way back up as many times as it takes!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Just you watch! I'm definitely gonna win 
next time!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Don't you go underestimatin' Golshi's 
bottomless power, ya hear!

Mystery dialect aside, she seems to have 
plenty of motivation.
